scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm just checking on the status of my application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. The loan product is a conventional first lien.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. I'm glad to hear that my application was approved. Could you please tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs of the loan? Also, I'm curious if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.998%. The total costs of the loan are $29,216.83. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have negative amortization.

dialogue.user: I see. Thank you for providing that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been sold to another institution. Your debt-to-income ratio is 45%, which is the ratio of your monthly debt payments to your monthly income.

dialogue.user:
Got it. That's all I needed to know for now. Thank you for your help.

<Neutral> I wasn't sure how my application would turn out, but I'm glad to have the details now. The information was clear, but I was hoping for a lower interest rate.
